text: The UEBA system flagged AVH0566's activity for Week 2010-W42 due to an unusual volume of logons outside their typical working hours. Specifically, there were 4 logons during this period, which is significantly higher than their recent average of 1-2 logons and exceeds the usual threshold by a factor of 3 (z=3.0). This anomaly suggests that AVH0566 may have been accessing systems or resources outside their normal working hours, warranting further investigation to determine the purpose and scope of this activity.
